headline: South Korean Brokerage Deposits Drop to 88.6 Trillion Won on Stock Volatility
summary: Investor deposits at South Korean securities brokerages plunged to 88.6 trillion won ($66.8 billion) amid persistent volatility in domestic equity markets.
why: Brokerage customer deposit levels in South Korea measure retail investor liquidity and sentiment, directly impacting transaction fees for securities firms.

impacts.name: South Korea
impacts.why: Retail investor capital outflows from domestic brokerages diminish equity trading liquidity.
